citation: Ettwiller L, Buswell J, Yigit E, Schildkraut I. 2016. BMC Genomics 17:199. A novel enrichment strategy reveals unprecedented number of novel transcription start sites at single base resolution in a model prokaryote and the gut microbiome.
datasetVersion: 12864_2016_2539_MOESM1_ESM.gtf (BMC Additional file 1, published 2016-03-08; publisher caption says 'Supplement ... Table S2' but the content is Supplemental Table 1, the 16,359 clustered Cappable-seq start sites on U00096.2). Score = relative read score (RRS, reads per million mapped).

notes: Records: 16352 of 16359 GTF rows. 6 rows dropped during liftover from U00096.2 to NC_000913.3: 4 with no exact match (their +/-20 bp window spans an insertion present only in U00096.3: IS1 between U00096.2 bases 257,907/257,908 inside crl, or IS5 between 1,298,721/1,298,722) and 2 whose +/-500 bp window still occurs 3 times in both assemblies (inside IS2 copies). 1 read-mapping artifact dropped: U00096.2 base 1 (+ strand, relative read score 2.205) lifted to NC_000913.3 base 1. Base 1 of a linear reference is where reads crossing the circular genome's origin are clipped, so a start site called there is not trustworthy. Not kept in records.json (reproducible from the build script): the log2 enrichment over the non-enriched control, the original U00096.2 position (it is in the record id) and the liftover anchor width. Not carried from the GTF: constant columns (seqname, source, feature, frame) and the redundant parts of the composite last column. The file has no promoter, gene, sigma factor or primary/secondary classification, so none is emitted. The paper's intergenic / intragenic sense / antisense labels and its 'known vs Cappable-seq-specific' labels (from a composite including RegulonDB 8.6) are not in the file and were not recomputed or imported. Additional file 2 (figures and supplement text) is used only to prove the label swap. No RegulonDB-derived content is included.
